lidc.title: The Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI): a completed reference database of lung nodules on CT scans.

fields.read_phases: 盲读 + 非盲读 两阶段
fields.lesions_ge3mm: 2669（至少 1 位医师标为 ≥3mm 结节）

lidc.quote: The Database contains 7371 lesions marked “nodule” by at least one radiologist. 2669 of these lesions were marked “nodule > or =3 mm” by at least one radiologist, of which <mark>928 (34.7%) received such marks from all four radiologists</mark>.
lidc.quoteZh: 数据库含 7371 个至少被一位医师标记为「结节」的病灶；其中 2669 个被标记为「≥3mm 结节」，而这 2669 个里只有 34.7%（928 个）得到四位医师的一致标注。

wan.title: Segmentation-perturbation propagation in pretrained foundation-model embeddings versus IBSI-aligned radiomics for radiologist-assessed lung-nodule malignancy classification on the LIDC-IDRI cohort.

fields.label_source: 放射科医师共识评分（非病理）
fields.perturbation: 每结节最多 13 种扰动掩膜；ICC(2,1) 跨 10 种条件
fields.split: 病人分组五折交叉验证
fields.classifier: L2 正则化逻辑回归 + bootstrap 95% CI
fields.stability: 稳定特征比例 90.2–92.5%（影像组学）/ 93.8%（BiomedCLIP）/ 75.0%（RadImageNet）

wan.quote: <mark>556 lung nodules (300 malignant, 256 benign from radiologist consensus ratings, not pathology) from 399 patients</mark> … Malignancy classification used L2-regularized logistic regression with <mark>patient-grouped five-fold cross-validation</mark> and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals … Perturbation stability is therefore decoupled from task-informativeness, and comparative benchmarks should report <mark>patient-grouped, size-stratified, calibration-aware metrics, not aggregate accuracy alone</mark>.
wan.quoteZh: 该研究在 399 位患者的 556 个肺结节（恶性 300 / 良性 256，标签来自放射科医师共识评分而非病理）上，用病人分组五折交叉验证评估恶性度分类；结论指出扰动稳定性与任务信息量是解耦的，比较性基准应报告病人分组、尺寸分层、校准感知的指标，而不是单一聚合准确率。
